Committee: Fiscal Responsibility and Economic Development
Sponsor: Rafferty
Analyst: Robin Rawls
Date: 02/25/2021
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 54 as passed the House of Representatives provides for the continuance of the Alabama Board of Athletic Trainers until October 1, 2025 pursuant to the Alabama Sunset Law. This bill will not otherwise affect state or federal funding.
Steve Livingston, Chairperson
Fiscal Responsibility and Economic Development
